prompts.title: SaaS Landing Page
prompts.text: Create a modern SaaS landing page with hero section, features grid with icons, pricing table (3 tiers), testimonials carousel, and a strong CTA. Use gradient accents and clean typography.

prompts.title: Product Launch Page
prompts.text: Build a product launch landing page with countdown timer, product hero image, key benefits section, early-access signup form, and social proof badges.

prompts.title: Agency Portfolio Landing
prompts.text: Create a creative agency landing page with fullscreen hero video/image, services overview, case studies grid, team section, and contact form.

prompts.title: Product Showcase Store
prompts.text: Build an e-commerce product page with image gallery, size/color selectors, add-to-cart button, product description tabs, related products carousel, and customer reviews section.

prompts.title: Digital Product Store
prompts.text: Create a digital product storefront with product cards, category filters, search bar, cart sidebar, and checkout form. Include download-after-purchase flow.

prompts.title: Developer Portfolio
prompts.text: Build a developer portfolio with animated hero intro, skills progress bars, project cards with live demo links, GitHub activity section, and contact form.

prompts.title: Photographer Portfolio
prompts.text: Create a minimal photographer portfolio with masonry image grid, lightbox viewer, category filters, about section, and booking form.

prompts.title: Tech Blog
prompts.text: Build a tech blog with featured post hero, post cards grid with tags and read time, sidebar with categories and popular posts, dark/light theme toggle, and newsletter signup.

prompts.title: Personal Blog
prompts.text: Create a minimal personal blog with clean typography, post list with excerpts, tag cloud, about page, and RSS feed link. Focus on readability.

prompts.title: Analytics Dashboard
prompts.text: Build an analytics dashboard with KPI cards (revenue, users, conversion rate), line chart for trends, bar chart for comparisons, data table with sorting, and date range picker.

prompts.title: Project Management Board
prompts.text: Create a Kanban-style project board with draggable task cards, columns (To Do, In Progress, Done), task detail modal, priority labels, and team member avatars.

prompts.title: Multi-step Form
prompts.text: Build a multi-step registration form with progress bar, field validation, step navigation (back/next), summary review step, and success confirmation page.

prompts.title: Calculator Tool
prompts.text: Create an interactive calculator tool (e.g. loan/mortgage calculator) with input sliders, real-time result updates, comparison chart, and PDF export button.

prompts.title: Newsletter Template
prompts.text: Build a responsive HTML email newsletter template with header logo, hero image, article sections with thumbnails, CTA buttons, social links footer. Must be table-based for email client compatibility.

prompts.title: Transactional Email
prompts.text: Create a transactional email template (order confirmation) with order summary table, shipping details, tracking button, and help/support footer. Table-based layout.

prompts.title: API Documentation
prompts.text: Build an API documentation page with sidebar navigation, endpoint sections (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), request/response code examples with syntax highlighting, authentication guide, and search.

prompts.title: Product Docs Site
prompts.text: Create a product documentation site with sidebar tree navigation, markdown-style content area, breadcrumbs, previous/next page links, and table of contents per page.

prompts.title: Browser Mini-game
prompts.text: Build a simple browser game (e.g. Snake, Tetris, or Memory) using HTML5 Canvas or DOM elements. Include score counter, high score storage (localStorage), start/pause/restart controls, and responsive layout.

prompts.title: Quiz Game
prompts.text: Create an interactive quiz game with question cards, multiple choice answers, timer per question, score tracking, progress bar, and final results screen with share button.

prompts.title: Restaurant Website
prompts.text: Build a restaurant website with fullscreen hero image, digital menu with categories and prices, reservation form with date/time picker, photo gallery, Google Maps embed, and contact info.

prompts.title: Local Business Site
prompts.text: Create a local business website with services list, business hours, team profiles, customer testimonials, location map, and contact form with WhatsApp button.
